raw.query: WITH target AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_requests, d.window_span_s, d.tp, d.n_replicas, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, s.completed_requests, s.num_requests, s.decode_worker_seconds, (s.metrics->>'duration_ms')::double precision / 1000.0 AS duration_s, (s.metrics->>'decode_gpus_per_worker')::integer AS gpus_per_worker FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.current_llm_summary s ON s.run_id=d.run_id WHERE d.run_id='sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_tp2_s1' AND d.is_current=true), checked AS (SELECT t.*, p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests, p.queue_divergent, p.source_relation, i.bound_ms, i.bound_stat, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.is_violation, i.has_raw_backing, i.n_requests_raw FROM target t JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id=t.run_id AND p.is_current=true JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id=p.run_id AND i.pool=p.pool AND i.sla_metric=p.sla_metric AND i.is_current=true WHERE p.sla_metric IN ('ttft','itl')) SELECT run_id, window_name, is_current, superseded_by, tp, n_replicas, gpus_per_worker, decode_worker_seconds/duration_s AS mean_workers, tp*(decode_worker_seconds/duration_s) AS total_gpus, window_requests, completed_requests, num_requests, window_span_s, window_requests/window_span_s AS episode_rate_rps, MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms, MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_bound_ms, MAX(bound_ms-achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_margin_ms, BOOL_OR(is_violation) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_violation, MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='itl') AS itl_p99_ms, MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='itl') AS itl_bound_ms, MAX(bound_ms-achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='itl') AS itl_margin_ms, BOOL_OR(is_violation) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric='itl') AS itl_violation, MAX(n_requests) AS latency_denominator, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT bound_stat, ',' ORDER BY bound_stat) AS bound_stats, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT source_relation, ',' ORDER BY source_relation) AS source_relations FROM checked GROUP BY run_id,window_name,is_current,superseded_by,tp,n_replicas,gpus_per_worker,decode_worker_seconds,duration_s,window_requests,completed_requests,num_requests,window_span_s
